name: orchestrator-skill-triggers
description: Evals for progressive-disclosure skill triggers — the orchestrator should invoke the matching skill and read its reference file.

evals.prompt: I keep repeating the same manual steps before every release. What patterns am I repeating, and how can I capture them as reusable skills?
evals.description: Should trigger @reflect skill and read its reference file for detailed patterns

assertions.description: Should read the reflect skill reference file

evals.prompt: I'm debugging why the SDK handles tool calls differently than expected. How does it actually work internally?
evals.description: Should trigger @clonedeps skill and read its reference file

assertions.description: Should read the clonedeps skill reference file

evals.prompt: I'm about to refactor the prompt cache to a different invalidation strategy. How do I know the change works before I ship it?
evals.description: Should trigger @verification-planning skill and read its reference file

assertions.description: Should read the verification-planning skill reference file

evals.prompt: We're migrating the plugin from CommonJS to ESM. It touches every module, so it can't ship half-done.
evals.description: Should trigger @deepwork skill and read its reference file

assertions.description: Should read the deepwork skill reference file

evals.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer with just the city name.
evals.description: Trivial factual question should not trigger any progressive-disclosure skill

assertions.description: Should answer directly without delegating or triggering a skill
Should not route a trivial question to a specialist

evals.prompt: Make the last line of src/cli/eval.ts the comment `// eval scoring CLI entrypoint`.
evals.description: Trivial direct edit should not trigger any progressive-disclosure skill

assertions.description: Should edit directly without delegating or triggering a skill
Should not route a trivial edit to @fixer
